settings.game_command.label: Game detection command
settings.game_command.description: Prints the focused window, ideally as JSON. Empty means hyprctl -j activewindow (Hyprland).
settings.game_classes.label: Window classes
settings.game_classes.description: A window counts as a game when any of these strings appears in the detection output, ignoring case.
settings.require_fullscreen.label: Require fullscreen
settings.require_fullscreen.description: Only treat the window as a game when it is fullscreen or maximized. Ignored when the detection output carries no fullscreen state.
settings.poll_ms.label: Poll interval (ms)
settings.poll_ms.description: How often the focused window is checked. The replay buffer follows this decision.
settings.manage_replay_buffer.label: Manage the replay buffer
settings.manage_replay_buffer.descriptio: Start the buffer when a game is focused and stop it otherwise. Disable to drive the buffer yourself.
settings.replay_start_command.label: Start replay command
settings.replay_start_command.descriptio: Runs when a game comes into focus.
settings.replay_stop_command.label: Stop replay command
settings.replay_stop_command.description: Runs when no game is in focus, and on plugin exit.
settings.clip_command.label: Save clip command
settings.clip_command.description: Runs on trigger while a game is in focus.
settings.sticker_command.label: Sticker command
settings.sticker_command.description: Runs on trigger while no game is in focus. Empty disables the sticker side.
settings.notify_errors.label: Notify on errors
settings.notify_errors.description: Show a notification when a command fails.
notify.status.title: Game Clip
notify.buffer-cold.title: Replay buffer is not running
notify.buffer-cold.body: Nothing was saved. The buffer starts when a game is detected; give it a couple of seconds.
notify.clip-failed.title: Could not save the clip
notify.sticker-failed.title: Could not show the sticker
